title: Organizer creates a Playoff
description: Create a Playoff end-to-end: pick the format, select players one by one (with a note on repeating), review the rating-seeded bracket (and rearrange rules), confirm first-round matches, and open the new tournament page.

steps.title: Organizer on Players
steps.body: Organizers see + Tournament. Playoff builds a single-elimination bracket from the selected roster.

steps.title: Start a tournament
steps.body: Open the type modal. You will choose Playoff before naming and selecting players.

steps.title: Tournament type modal
steps.body: Formats include Round Robin, Playoff, Multi RR, Preliminary compounds, and Swiss.

steps.title: Choose Playoff
steps.body: Select Playoff / Bracket for a single-elimination event with automatic winner advancement.

steps.title: Playoff selected
steps.body: The selected format is highlighted. Optionally set a name, then continue to player selection.

steps.title: Continue to players
steps.body: Advance to the shared player picker. Playoff needs at least four players (eight fills a clean power-of-two bracket).

steps.title: Player selection
steps.body: Each row has a checkbox. You build the field by selecting members one at a time.
steps.resultNote: Wizard moved to the player selection step.

steps.title: Select a player
steps.body: Check one member to add them to the Playoff field.

steps.title: One player included
steps.body: That member is now counted in the selection total. Playoff still needs more players before you can continue.
steps.resultNote: First checkbox applied; selection count increased by one.

steps.title: More selections work the same
steps.body: You can check several more players the same way. The next screen skips those repeated clicks and shows a full enough roster for the bracket.

steps.title: Roster filled in
steps.body: After repeating the selection, enough members are checked. Continue opens the seeded bracket preview.
steps.resultNote: Multiple players selected behind the scenes for the Playoff field.

steps.title: Continue to bracket
steps.body: Leave player selection and open the bracket organizer. Seeds are placed automatically; you can drag to rearrange.

steps.title: Bracket preview
steps.body: The bracket shows first-round slots (and BYEs when the field is not a power of two). Initial pairing comes from ratings; you can rearrange before continuing.
steps.resultNote: Playoff bracket organize step is open with a seeded preview.

steps.title: Rearranging the bracket
steps.body: Initial pairing is based on ratings. You can rearrange by dragging players from one spot to another. Rules: (1) No pair can be left without players — a match cannot end up empty. (2) To replace a player, move them to the temporary drop zone first, introduce the new opponent into the freed slot, then move the held player against their intended opponent.

steps.title: Continue to first round
steps.body: When the bracket looks right, continue to review the first-round matchups.

steps.title: First round matches
steps.body: Review who plays whom in round one, then create the Playoff.
steps.resultNote: First Round Matches list and Create Tournament are visible.

steps.title: Create the tournament
steps.body: Finalize creation. The app opens the new Playoff page with the live bracket.

steps.title: Tournament page
steps.body: You land on the Playoff detail view with the bracket ready for day-of scoring.
steps.resultNote: Create Tournament succeeded; detail page shows the Playoff event.
